mentions.name: Dragonfly
mentions.description: A VS Code extension for testing REST APIs directly inside VS Code. It understands Next.js and Express.js codebases and generates a collection of all routes with body parameters in one click.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://www.usedragonfly.xyz/. Dragonfly is a VS Code extension to test REST APIs directly inside VS Code. It understands your Next.js and Express.js codebase and creates a collection of all your routes with body parameters in one click.
mentions.author: saurowankhade
